title: tui: the issue as the first post on the detail screen
body: Title block with the id dim and the title bold; one badge line with priority, kind, status, assignee and lease; a dim dates line; a small labelled table of parent, children, blockers and labels, only the rows that apply; then the body as the first box, with the creation time, branch and commit in its borders, and the notes below as now.
close_reason: header built as proposed; detail unit test checks every line at width 40

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Done as proposed: id dim and title bold, one badge line, a dim dates line with deferral and close resolution/reason, a ten-column labelled ties table (parent with title, children with the rollup or count, blockers with status, labels), the body as the first box with the creation stamp in its borders and no author since the record has none, notes below. post_box() replaced note_box() and serves both.
